description: Source code for TinyMCE BBCode plugin defining plugin info, content cleanup, and conversion methods between HTML and BBCode in PunBB dialect.

classes.name: TinyMCE_BBCodePlugin
classes.description: Object containing methods for BBCode plugin info, cleanup, and conversion functions.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns plugin metadata such as name, author, URL, and version.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Converts content between HTML and BBCode depending on the context and dialect.

methods.name: _punbb_html2bbcode
methods.description: Converts HTML content to BBCode in PunBB dialect.

methods.name: _punbb_bbcode2html
methods.description: Converts BBCode in PunBB dialect to HTML.
